row132_before:
These women's white trousers are cut for a barrel-leg cut. The woven fabric is 55% linen and 45% viscose. The plain finish leaves room for another texture or print.

They have an elasticated waist. The design includes front and side pockets; the legs finish with a straight hem. Machine wash cold and wash dark colours separately. Do not bleach; remove promptly and dry in the shade.

Styling note - Try them with a plain navy top and flat sandals for daytime plans. Add a short jacket and switch to loafers for dinner, keeping the layers simple so the proportions stay clear.

Product ID: l-pants-17753-21737-white
